options.name: adom
options.description: The administrative domain (admon) the configuration belongs to

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the device to be provisioned.

options.name: group
options.description: The name of the device group the provisioned device can belong to.

options.name: minor_release
options.description: The minor release number such as 6.X.1, as X being the minor release.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the device to be provisioned.

options.name: os_type
options.description: The Fortinet OS type to be pushed to the device, such as 'FOS' for FortiOS.

options.name: os_version
options.description: The Fortinet OS version to be used for the device, such as 5.0 or 6.0.

options.name: password
options.description: The password associated with the username account.

options.name: patch_release
options.description: The patch release number such as 6.0.X, as X being the patch release.

options.name: platform
options.description: The platform of the device, such as model number or VM.

options.name: policy_package
options.description: The name of the policy package to be assigned to the device.

options.name: serial
options.description: The serial number of the device that will be provisioned.

options.name: username
options.description: The username to log into the FortiManager

options.name: vdom
options.description: The virtual domain (vdom) the configuration belongs to
